Paragraph: Then Hanuma the son of Air, gladly gave a well-flowered branch of sandalwood tree to Lakshmana...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Extending hospitality and comfort to Lakshmana as well.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman thoughtfully provides a flowering sandalwood branch for Lakshmana's comfort.
Outcome/Resolution: Ensures all participants are included in the hospitality.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Thoughtful hospitality and consideration for others

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Atithi-satkara (thoughtful care and hospitality toward companions)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Extending mindful care (satkara) to all members of the allied party.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Demonstrating emotional intelligence and situational awareness through acts of inclusion.
